nodes.description: Public counter of tokens minted in PolaroidNights, incremented inside mint().
Public base URI string used to build token metadata URIs.
Maximum token supply tracked by WithLimitedSupply (172 for this collection).
Counters.Counter tracking how many tokens have been minted.
Mapping used by RandomlyAssigned to shuffle/bucket token indices.
Initial token id offset used by RandomlyAssigned (1 for this collection).
Owner address stored by Ownable and set in the constructor.
Constructor: sets ERC721 name/symbol, RandomlyAssigned supply/start, assigns owner and pre-mints 3 tokens to msg.sender.
Payable mint function with supply, availability, tx.origin, price and per-wallet balance checks; mints via nextToken/_safeMint and increments currentSupply.
Returns metadata URI by concatenating baseURI, token id and '.json'.
onlyOwner function that sends the entire contract balance to msg.sender using send().
Internal override returning the baseURI state variable.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken override: derives a pseudo-random index from block/msg fields and pops an unused token id.
Returns the maximum supply (_totalSupply).
Returns the current Counters.Counter value.
Returns totalSupply() - tokenCount(); arithmetic on supply counters.
Internal function to raise the maximum supply; writes _totalSupply after a require check.
Ownable.owner() accessor reading the _owner state variable; basis of the onlyOwner modifier.
ERC721 internal safe mint that mints and then calls _checkOnERC721Received on contract recipients.
External call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, invoking untrusted callback code.
ERC721 internal mint writing _balances and _owners.
ERC721 internal transfer updating balances/ownership after approval checks.
Ownable onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Ownable onlyOwner function renouncing ownership.
Caller-controlled address used for mint pricing checks, balance limits and as withdrawal recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp fed into the pseudo-random seed in nextToken.
Origin address used in the tx.origin == msg.sender anti-contract check inside mint.
Low-level value send of the whole contract balance; external interaction that can revert or consume gas.
Untrusted external callback onERC721Received executed during _safeMint before mint bookkeeping finishes.
Weak pseudo-random number derived from msg.sender, block.coinbase/difficulty/gaslimit/timestamp.
currentSupply++ state mutation performed after _safeMint in mint().
Recipient address parameter of mint().
Token id parameter of tokenURI() used for existence check and URI building.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership().
Constructor parameter used to initialize _totalSupply.
Local variable in mint() holding the token id returned by nextToken().
Local in nextToken: totalSupply() - tokenCount(), bound for the random modulo.
Local in nextToken holding the modulo-reduced random index.
Local in nextToken holding the chosen token value before adding startFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender drives the mint price/owner checks and balance-of limits in mint().
tx.origin is compared with msg.sender in mint(), relying on an untrusted origin value for access control.
block.timestamp is part of the keccak256 seed used to pick the token id, making minting timestamp/coinbase dependent.
mint() calls nextToken() to obtain the token id.
mint() calls _safeMint(_to, id) to create the token.
mint() reaches an untrusted onERC721Received callback through _safeMint before currentSupply is incremented.
mint() increments the currentSupply counter after the external interaction.
mint() calls availableTokenCount() in its supply guards.
mint() compares msg.sender against owner() to decide whether payment and wallet limits apply.
The _to parameter flows into _safeMint inside mint().
The constructor calls mint(msg.sender) three times for the pre-mint.
Constructor initializes the ownership state variable via Ownable/_transferOwnership.
tokenId parameter flows into the existence check and URI construction in tokenURI().
tokenURI() calls _baseURI() to fetch the metadata prefix.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
withdraw() performs an external value send of the contract balance before returning.
The withdrawal send targets msg.sender.
withdraw() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which reads owner().
transferOwnership() is gated by onlyOwner via owner().
renounceOwnership() is gated by onlyOwner via owner().
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written by transferOwnership().
_safeMint invokes the untrusted onERC721Received callback on contract recipients.
_checkOnERC721Received performs the external receiver callback.
_safeMint requires _checkOnERC721Received to succeed.
nextToken computes a weak pseudo-random index from block and msg fields.
nextToken computes maxIndex = totalSupply() - tokenCount().
maxIndex is the modulus applied to the random seed to produce random.
The random index is used to read/write the tokenMatrix mapping.
The selected token value has startFrom added before being returned.
nextToken calls super.nextToken() which increments the token counter.
tokenCount() returns the Counters.Counter state _tokenCount.
availableTokenCount() calls totalSupply().
availableTokenCount() subtracts tokenCount() from totalSupply().
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable.
_setSupply writes the new _totalSupply value.
The constructor parameter totalSupply_ initializes _totalSupply.
Local id returned by nextToken() is passed into _safeMint.
The increment operation mutates the currentSupply state variable.
